CustomField.description: When CursorBatchLedgerCleanup was last enqueued. Stamped by the coordinator on job submission and used to throttle the sweep to once per day. Clearing this field forces a sweep on the next job submission.
CustomField.inlineHelpText: When the event ledger was last swept. Clear this to force a sweep on the next job submission.
CustomField.label: Last Ledger Sweep
